items.q: No, not Howard White, this Phil Dorsey

ctx.x: No, not Howard White, this Phil Dorsey (Inaudible). At the same time, before then we--they were doing doing this taxi dance, ten cents a dance, and we got to play a few of those and it caught on I go to Ponca (phonetic spelling) City.
